claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Bergenin is a weakly cytotoxic natural product with no potent annotated target engagement at 2.5 uM; any killing is likely non-selective, possibly via weak cationic amphiphilic/lysosomal stress or general metabolic interference rather than IL1B/TNF inhibition.
